beta.notes:
• Update alerts: Home banner (What's new / Install now / Later), badge on Updates and the tray icon, one notification per version, tray install item
• Keeps working while updating: background download and verification while connected
• "Install when I disconnect", or "Install now" which reconnects your profile automatically afterwards
• Safe upgrades: a failed install keeps the current version, with a notice and Retry
• Checks at start and every 6 hours
